title: Gemini Dollar launch context
description: Gemini Dollar was launched as a Gemini-issued USD stablecoin. SOG records this as launch, issuer, reserve-attestation, and Ethereum deployment context.

title: Liquity V1 and LUSD lifecycle context
description: Liquity introduced LUSD as part of its crypto-collateralized borrowing protocol. SOG records this as protocol lifecycle context, separate from later Liquity V2 and BOLD treatment.
notes: PR-038 event expansion. Exact launch-date source should be strengthened later.

title: crvUSD launches
description: Curve Finance’s official second-anniversary statement identifies May 14, 2023 as the crvUSD launch date. SOG retains the existing event ID and records LLAMMA and collateral mechanics as separate protocol context.
notes: Launch-date Batch O replaces the earlier approximate 2023-05-01 context date with Curve’s anniversary-backed date.

title: Ethena USDe launches publicly
description: Ethena Labs marked 19 February 2024 as USDe’s official public launch.
notes: Official public-launch evidence replaces the earlier approximate 2024-02-01 context date.

title: eUSD trial predecessor launches and is later phased out
description: Havven released the ETH-backed eUSD trial on April 11, 2018. eUSD was a prototype predecessor with a different collateral model; issuance stopped before the HAV-backed nUSD launch, and redemption closed on June 29, 2018.
notes: eUSD is recorded as a predecessor, not as an alias or the canonical launch identity of current sUSD.

title: Frax launch context
description: Frax entered operation as a USD-pegged protocol stablecoin. SOG records this as the starting point for FRAX collateral, AMO, governance, and non-redeemability lifecycle context.
notes: Uses the canonical launch date and existing Frax primary documentation.

title: TrueUSD launch context
description: TrueUSD entered the market as a USD-backed stablecoin. SOG records this as the starting point for issuer, reserve-attestation, redemption, and multichain lifecycle context.
notes: Uses the canonical launch date and existing TrueUSD primary sources.

title: Ripple USD launches globally
description: Ripple made RLUSD available on global exchanges beginning December 17, 2024. SOG records this as the product launch date while keeping issuer, reserve-attestation, legal-terms, and deployment context as separate layers.
notes: Official Ripple launch announcement added in launch-date Batch L; the legacy event ID is retained for reference stability.

title: Euro Coin launches on Ethereum
description: Circle launched its euro-backed stablecoin on Ethereum on June 30, 2022 under the Euro Coin / EUROC name. SOG treats the later EURC name and symbol as the same continuous asset identity.
notes: Official Circle launch announcement added in launch-date Batch L; the legacy event ID is retained for reference stability.

title: Pax Dollar launch context
description: Pax Dollar entered the market under its earlier Paxos Standard identity. SOG records this as the starting point for Paxos issuer, reserve-report, redemption, and deployment lifecycle context.
notes: Uses the canonical launch date and existing Paxos primary sources.

title: Global Dollar launch context
description: Global Dollar entered operation within the Global Dollar Network and Paxos-related issuer structure. SOG records this as launch, backing, redemption, partner-network, and unresolved deployment context.
notes: Uses the canonical launch date and existing network and issuer primary sources.

title: USDS launch and Sky transition context
description: USDS entered the Sky Protocol ecosystem during the MakerDAO-to-Sky transition. SOG records DAI-to-USDS lifecycle, protocol collateral, sUSDS savings-token, and interface context as separate layers.
notes: Uses the canonical launch date and existing Sky primary sources.

title: sUSD remains in a severe market depeg
description: An indexed Ethereum market observation showed sUSD near $0.3104 on June 18, 2026, after Synthetix had already acknowledged that sUSD had traded below $0.70 for months. SOG records a severe unresolved depeg without treating one venue observation or an unverified quote as a universal redemption value or canonical all-time low.
notes: The $0.3104 observation is source-specific. User-provided screenshots suggested executable quotes near $0.74 and later $0.25 for 10,000 sUSD, but route, pool, block, chain, and timestamp were not canonicalized and those quotes are not stored as the official low.

title: SIP-423 proposes legacy sUSD retirement and SNX compensation
description: SIP-423 entered Vote Pending status with a proposal to retire legacy sUSD on Ethereum and Optimism, suspend transfer, mint, and burn functions after a successful vote, snapshot eligible holdings, close the 420 Pool structure, reform staking exits, and offer a proposed entitlement of four newly minted SNX per eligible sUSD. The proposal is not approved or implemented.
notes: Vote Pending is distinct from Approved and Implemented. Snapshot block, final eligibility, claim contract, claim opening, vesting clock, expiration treatment, and execution transactions remain unresolved.

title: Havven launches nUSD on Ethereum mainnet
description: Havven deployed nUSD to Ethereum mainnet on June 11, 2018 as its first HAV-backed nomin. SOG uses this as the canonical launch of the continuous asset later renamed sUSD.
notes: The earlier ETH-backed eUSD trial is a predecessor and not the same launch boundary.

title: nUSD is renamed sUSD during the Synthetix rebrand
description: Havven announced its transition to Synthetix on November 30, 2018 and mapped nUSD to sUSD. The announcement stated that contract addresses would not change, so SOG treats this as a same-token rebrand rather than a new stablecoin launch.
notes: The December 7 Synth launch confirmed that sUSD had already been live since June as nUSD.
